cmp-prisma.text: Probe component — narrative carries every F3 escape hazard: a literal </script><script>alert(1)</script> tag, an HTML comment opener <!--, a Unicode LINE SEPARATOR (U+2028), and the literal sentinel string /*<SSOT:VIEWMODEL_JSON>*/ appearing inside prose. _escape_viewmodel_json must neutralize all of these.

micro:prisma/seed.ts.text: Secondary injection entry — another U+2028 inside the prose, plus a nested <!-- comment marker. Used to verify the escape is applied to every entry, not just the first.
